artworks.title: Saint Joachim Embracing Saint Anna
artworks.description: The image shows two figures embracing each other closely. They are positioned face to cheek in a gentle manner. The figure on the left has a covered head, while the figure on the right has a long beard and short hair. Both individuals wear long, flowing robes. They are in an architectural setting with solid structures in the background, along with some foliage on the left side.

artworks.title: David Praying
artworks.description: The image shows a man kneeling on the ground. He has curly hair, a beard, and is dressed in a long robe. His hands are clasped together in a prayer gesture and he is looking upward. Next to him is a large harp. In the background is a large building with ornate architecture and a figure of a man with a bishop's miter in the sky. There are trees and mountains in the background.

artworks.title: Joseph Interprets the Dreams in Prison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring three seated figures and two vision-like scenes in the background. The central figure appears to be a woman seated between two men, each dressed in robes and hats. They are positioned in front of large architectural columns. The two men are on either side of the central figure; the one on the right is wearing a plumed hat. There are chains on the floor in front of them. In the background, two ovals contain images of separate scenes. The left oval shows a figure walking while carrying something on their head. The right oval depicts a person seemingly emerging from flames or surrounded by vapor. The scene is meticulously rendered with fine lines.

artworks.title: Potiphar's Wife Accusing Joseph
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures set against a background depicting a rising sun over a distant landscape. The drawing showcases several figures, dressed in flowing robes and elaborate headdresses, arranged in a narrative scene. To the left, two individuals in detailed clothing approach a kneeling figure. On the right, several standing figures, some wearing extravagant hats, are engaged in or observing a central action. Behind them, a rustic structure provides depth, as the sun rises over a hilly landscape with buildings silhouetted against a textured sky. The scene is intricately detailed, emphasizing the folds of the fabric and expressions of the figures, and is rendered entirely in shades of black and grey.

artworks.title: Joseph Escaping Potiphar's Wife
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring two figures in motion. The setting contains a room with a bed, visible bed and pillows in the background. One figure on the left is wearing flowing garments and engaging with another figure on the right, who is wearing a detailed cloak. Various objects such as footwear, a fur-lined object, and a container are scattered on the floor. The room includes architectural details like drapery and a textured wall. Subtle details of a smaller room or a cabinet with two figures in the background can be seen. The drawing employs intricate line work and hatching techniques indicative of engravings or etchings.

artworks.title: Joseph Interprets His Dream to Jacob
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in an architectural setting. The individuals are dressed in historical or classical attire, with many holding staffs. The detailed composition includes clothing texture, expressions, columns, and an archway. The figures are arranged in a narrative manner, with one seated to the right, possibly in a position of authority.

artworks.title: Abraham Repudiating Hagar
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an older man, a woman, a child, and a small dog standing in a rocky landscape. The drawing is detailed and likely created using etching or engraving techniques. The older man is on the left, wearing a robe and holding a staff. The woman holds a jug, the child looks out, and the dog sniffs the ground. In the background, there are trees, rocks, and buildings. The drawing is monochromatic, emphasizing line work and shading for texture and detail.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.8 x 7.8 cm (4 5/8 x 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene featuring two figures and a tree with a serpent. The scene highlights two nude figures, one standing and one seated, with the standing figure holding a leafy branch and the seated figure holding a round object. Behind the seated figure is a tree entwined by a serpent which gazes towards the figures. The composition is framed by lush foliage and a hilly landscape in the background. The drawing uses intricate lines and shading to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve Lamenting the Death of Abel
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.3 x 11.6 cm (6 7/16 x 4 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures set against a rocky landscape. The central figure is a nude female with drapery swirling around her body, raising her left arm. To her left, an old male figure stands. Below them lies a figure on the ground, partially covered by cloth. The background shows rocks, sparse vegetation, trees, and hills. The drawing is intricate and showcases a high level of detail typical of Northern European print work of the 16th century.

artworks.title: Cain Killing Abel
artworks.description: The image depicts two human figures in an intense scene. Both figures' entire bodies are visible. The figure on the left is seated on the ground, with one arm supporting itself and the other reaching out towards the other figure. This figure has long, wavy hair and is draped with a cloth covering part of the body. The facial expression appears tense or pained. The other figure, positioned above and to the right, is lunging forward, with a dynamic pose suggesting movement. This figure has curly hair and is primarily unclothed, with a cloth loosely wrapped around. The left hand is grasping the outstretched arm of the seated figure, and the right hand holds an agricultural tool. The background reveals rugged terrain with rocks and trees, and large clouds are visible in the sky. A stone with the date "1529" inscribed is placed prominently in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Explusion from Paradise
artworks.description: The image shows two human figures in full-body detail. The figure on the left is a male with short hair, an elongated face, and a stern expression. They are holding a leafy branch and stepping forward. The figure on the right is a female with long hair and a tense expression, slightly turned towards the male. Both figures are unclothed. Above them in the clouds is another figure with a sword, depicted as descending. The background features rocky landscapes, mountains, and dramatic clouds.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two nude figures in a natural setting. The scene depicts the figures situated in a landscape filled with trees and rocky formations. A large tree stands prominently on the right side of the composition, around which one figure is positioned, reaching out with one hand. The other figure is seated on a rock formation, holding an object in their hand. The drawing employs intricate line work and hatching to create shading and texture. The year 1529 is inscribed above the figures.

artworks.title: The First Prohibition
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.5 x 11.8 cm (6 1/2 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures standing in a landscape. The foreground features two unclothed figures on the right, and a robed figure on the left. The robed figure is gesturing towards the tree, while the two figures to the right are holding onto one another, with one of them holding a leafy branch. The background is a landscape that includes trees and distant mountains. The drawing is executed in intricate detail with precise shading.

artworks.title: The Pilgrims
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two elderly figures engaged in conversation in a natural setting, accompanied by a distant traveler. The scene is intricately depicted in black and white, capturing a moment of interaction between two figures seated on a rocky landscape under the shade of leafy trees. One figure appears to be in a kneeling position, supported by a crutch, looking intently at the other, who is seated and donned in a furry hat, holding an object. In the background, a third figure is seen walking, leaning on a stick. The surrounding landscape features trees and distant hills.

artworks.title: The Fool and the Woman
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from the waist up. The figure on the left is an older man facing slightly to the right, leaning forward with his head close to the other figure. He has a pronounced nose, deep-set eyes, and prominent wrinkles. The man is wearing a hooded garment with scalloped edges and layered fabric, and a belt around his waist with a hanging pouch. The second figure is a younger woman positioned slightly to the right, with her body turned away from the older man. Her facial features are softer, with a small nose and closed eyes. She wears a fitted garment with a cloth covering her head and a belt with a circular buckle. The background shows a textured surface, resembling a wooden structure or tree, indicating an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: The Two Couples in the Forest
artworks.description: The image shows four people almost in full-body. They are positioned closely together, with three of them walking while one appears to be standing nearby. The central figure is a woman with intricate, plaited hair adorned with a headpiece. She is wearing a detailed, long-sleeved dress with layers and embroidery. Beside her, a man with long, unkempt hair is walking and pointing. He is wearing a tunic and hose. To the left, another woman stands in profile with her hair covered by a headdress and wrapped in multiple layers of clothes. Behind her, another man with a hat and long cloak is present. They are surrounded by a natural setting, with trees and foliage in the background. The scene is depicted in detailed linework typical of historical engravings, with rich textures in clothing and natural elements.

artworks.title: The Promenade
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing closely together. The woman on the left leans slightly towards the man. She wears a long dress with patterns and a head covering. The man, on the right, is turned slightly towards the woman. Both hold an object between them. The background includes trees and architectural elements.

artworks.title: A Young Man with Eight Armed Men
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men depicted in an intricately detailed black and white drawing. They are shown from the knees up, standing closely together, with each figure slightly overlapping the others. The central figure wears a loose garment that appears to be a robe, with long sleeves and a cap on his head, his head turned slightly to the side. His facial features are serious and include a straight nose and thin lips. His hair is short and tightly fitted beneath his cap. The man to his right has longer, slightly curly hair, and he looks straight ahead while gesturing with his left hand. Both men wear similar attire, consisting of knee-length coats, visible buttons, and hats. The men around them are wearing brimmed hats and similar robes and coats, with one of them holding what appears to be the hilt of a sword. The background consists of a plain setting, with no distinguishable features other than the textured ground beneath their feet.

artworks.title: The Savior Standing with the Globe and Cross in His Left Hand
artworks.description: The image shows a standing male figure with long hair and a beard, wearing a draped cloth around his waist. His torso and lower legs are bare, and he has a cloak draped over one shoulder that extends to the ground. He is holding a sphere with a cross in one hand and gesturing with the other hand. There is a halo around his head, and two columns frame the figure in the background.

artworks.title: Two Cupids in Two Circles
artworks.description: This drawing shows two winged infants or cherubs in circular frames. The left circle features a cherub walking with a plant and a bow, set against a landscape with a tree and mountains. The right circle shows a cherub playing a horn while riding on another figure. The circles are connected by a small rectangular cartouche with the letter "L" inscribed. The artwork uses fine linework and hatching for texture and form.

artworks.title: Two Cupids Seated on Clouds in Two Circles
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cherubs within ornate medallions. The left medallion features a cherub holding a torch and an arrow, while the right medallion shows another cherub clothed in a draped garment, holding a staff topped with a cross. Both cherubs are depicted seated on clouds, with wings spread behind them. The surrounding design includes elaborate scrollwork and foliage.

artworks.title: Triton and Siren in Tendrils
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mythical creatures holding shields amidst ornamental foliage. The drawing features two stylized, mythical creatures positioned within separate circular frames made of elaborate foliage motifs. On the left, a creature with the torso of a man and a long flowing beard clutches a shield-like object. On the right, a creature with a human upper body and the tail of a fish holds a shield. Both figures are set against a background dense with swirling, leaf-like decorations. At the bottom center, between the creatures, there is a square compartment with the letter 'L'. The style suggests intricate Renaissance ornamental elements with a significant emphasis on curves and textures.

artworks.title: Two Naked Children Supporting a Blank Shield
artworks.description: Printed with fine black lines and delicate crosshatching, two nude, chubby boys together brace a shield in this horizontal print. The shield sits with the pointed bottom on the floor and each boy holding one upper corner. The boy to the right rests one foot up on a helmet and holds a lance with a fluttering, forked banner in his other hand. He looks down to our right over his rounded, sloping shoulder. The boy to our left kneels with his left hand, to our right, holding the other side of the shield. A string is tied around the foot of a bird perched on a ledge to the left. The boy holds the other end of the string and looks at the bird. The space behind the boys is shallow, and there is the suggestion of some architectural ornament where the wall comes toward us to the left. The artist signed the print with an uppercase “L” on a square tablet, which leans against the corner of the wall to the left and the floor.

artworks.title: Two Boys with a Helmet and a Standard
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals walking. The figure on the left carries a shield, while the figure behind holds a large flag. Both are dressed in flowing garments. The background is simple, with a rocky ground and textured sky. A signature and date in the corner indicate an engraving from 1523.
